title.en: The globe, the equator and hemispheres

text.en:
Meena turned the globe and found a line around the middle.
"That is the equator," said her teacher.

A globe is a model of the Earth. The equator is an imaginary line around the middle at 0 degrees latitude, dividing the Earth into the Northern and Southern Hemispheres.
The Prime Meridian at 0 degrees longitude passes through Greenwich and divides the Earth into the Eastern and Western Hemispheres.
India lies in the Northern and Eastern Hemispheres.

problem.en: In which hemispheres does India lie?

text.en: India is north of the equator.
India is east of the Prime Meridian.

prompt.en: A friend says the equator divides the Earth into East and West. How will you reply?

requiredIdeas.en: The Prime Meridian divides East and West.
